title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP in Burundi is implemented by 3 partners COPED, SADC and AFJB in Makamba, Nyanza, Rumonge communes of Burunga Province and at national level. It aims to tackle the root causes of gender inequality and social exclusion. The programme supports furthest behind rights holders to organise and advocate for their priorities to local government and engages power holders at commune, provincial and national level to engage with and respond to community concerns through Provincial Exchange Platforms and follow up. It supports SRHR service effectiveness and engagement with communities and especially youth, and effective coordination of peacebuilding structures in the community. At national level, partners coordinated with CSOs to progress harmonisation of GBV laws resulting in the Judiciary Committee validating a draft revised law and advocated on challenges in handling GBV cases due to legislative discrepancies. In 2025, it reached 1,852 people directly (49% women) and an estimated 31,806 people indirectly. . Programme objectives are not thematic. The primary purpose of the programme is to promote and support gender equality, including sexual and reproductive health rights. Work that contributes to specific SDG targets will span all objectives through complementary approaches and actions.
